title: Integration sweep: mosh phases 3-4 end to end
description:
Root integration sweep for mosh-19g (super-design §Coverage). Verify the goal's main flows end to end and add the integration tests no per-seam bead covers; sweep for unwired config values, parameters and interfaces; fix small gaps inline, file blockers for big ones.
owns: the three-phase end-to-end scenario (R15), the merged-tree hook budget check (R11).
Acceptance:
- [ ] One opt-in scenario (#[ignore], timing_lock()) runs a QUIC leg through UdpRelay at 150 ms one-way and 10 % loss with supersede on and HERDR_MOSH_PREDICT=on: typing shows predictions, output keeps advancing, a relay rebind mid-run resumes on the same connection, and there is no client disconnect.
- [ ] scripts/mosh-diff-budget.sh passes at 30 on the merged tree, and its count is recorded in the root spec's Post-Implementation Notes.
- [ ] Full sweep green: cargo nextest run --locked --no-fail-fast, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check.
- [ ] grep finds no unused fork constant, capability or env var (HERDR_MOSH_QUIC, HERDR_MOSH_PREDICT, QUIC_SILENCE_WINDOW, x-mosh-* kinds and capabilities) — each is read somewhere.

title: 4: server EchoTracker and echo hooks
description:
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction--4-prediction-design.md §1, §2 and Key abstractions (EchoTracker / server_hooks). In src/mosh/server_hooks.rs: EchoTracker process-global mutex keyed by client id (per pane received, acked, FIFO of (count, received_at)), never held across a channel send; the subscribe arm in 3b's client EndpointControl dispatch creates the entry (no ServerEvent); receipt counting for subscribed clients; echo_due(clients, now) queues x-mosh.echo-ack.v1 (EchoAck encoding) on the client's existing control lane (upstream writer queue, no 3b dependency) for input received ≥ 50 ms earlier with the client's last committed surface_revision via render_state.last_pane_surface() (no baseline → wait); echo_deadline(next_deadline) folds the next due time in; disconnect cleanup. Upstream hook lines (each one tagged statement): count at client_transport.rs:1196; echo_due before headless.rs step 8 (~:608); echo_deadline folded into next_deadline; cleanup in remove_client (headless.rs:946); status.rs advertising x-mosh-echo-v1.
owns: EchoTracker behaviour, server echo hook lines, capability x-mosh-echo-v1.
Files: src/mosh/server_hooks.rs, src/server/client_transport.rs, src/server/headless.rs, src/cli/status.rs.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Unit tests: unsubscribed clients are not counted; ack only after 50 ms; ack carries the last committed revision; no baseline → no ack until one exists; remove_client drops the entry.
- [ ] Server-level test: a subscribed client typing into a pane receives echo-acks whose input_seq equals the events it sent; an unsubscribed client receives none.
- [ ] Server-level test: input that causes no render (stty -echo) is still acked.
- [ ] status client --json lists x-mosh-echo-v1; scripts/mosh-diff-budget.sh passes at 30 (needs: mosh-19g.5).
- [ ] clippy and fmt clean.

description:
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction--4-prediction-design.md §3 and Key abstractions (client fork facade, Predictor painting). outage.rs facade: one process-global mutex for OutageState + Predictor; observe becomes one closed match (LINK_KIND → outage state + Predictor srtt/echo from LinkStatus; echo-ack → Predictor; else false); paint paints banner then predictions and moves frame.cursor past the last visible prediction; new entry points tap (counts every ClientShellPaneInput request, creates predictions, returns a recomposed frame when one was added) and blocks_fast_path (true while any prediction exists for the active endpoint). title: 4: EchoAck and Predictor core
description:
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction--4-prediction-design.md §3 and Key abstractions (EchoAck, Predictor). src/mosh/predict.rs (mounted as a #[path] child of outage.rs, no upstream line): EchoAck (kind strings for echo-ack and echo-subscribe, ack JSON {pane_id,input_seq,surface_revision}, malformed → none); Predictor: mode enum from HERDR_MOSH_PREDICT read once (off default | on | adaptive), state keyed by (endpoint id, connection generation) then pane, input class match (Printable / EpochBreak / ClearPane / Ignore incl. key releases and modifier-only keys), sent counter per pane, prediction creation only when echo on and the mode threshold met (adaptive > 60 ms; underline > 160 ms), cursor placement with unicode-width and right-edge stop, epochs with adaptive hidden-until-confirmed, judging (ack input_seq ≥ seq AND surface revision ≥ ack revision; inner_rect change clears), wrong → clear pane + hide epoch, no-ack timeout max(1 s, 4×SRTT) → clear + off for the generation; a pure 'cells to paint + cursor position' output and an 'any prediction exists' query. No I/O; time is an input. Before building the keying, read-only verify that the client's pane_surface_generation is numbered like the registry's connection.generation; if not, key by the value the paint hook can see and note it in the spec's Post-Implementation Notes.
owns: EchoAck, Predictor.
Files: src/mosh/predict.rs, src/mosh/outage.rs (mount line only).
Acceptance:
- [ ] Unit tests: every input class; epoch break / hidden epoch / confirm reveals; paste and rect-change clear; right-edge stop; wide characters; ack ahead of its surface leaves the prediction pending; wrong prediction clears the pane; timeout turns prediction off; generation change resets counts.
- [ ] Mode thresholds unit-tested (off, on, adaptive below/above 60 ms, underline above 160 ms).
- [ ] EchoAck round-trips; malformed JSON → none.
- [ ] No upstream file changed; clippy and fmt clean.

Coverage r1: the mode enum and its single read function are public for the bridge (mosh-19g.3.4); EchoAck also defines the capability constant x-mosh-echo-v1 used by the status line (3.3) and the bridge probe (3.4).

Design roast r1: the counting unit is one element of ClientShellPaneInput.events, counted at the tap; counts are per (connection generation, pane) and reset only on a new generation.

title: 3b: LocalBridge render hosting, resync path and resume rule
description:
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction--3b-supersede-design.md §3, §4 and Key abstractions (LocalBridge, Hello). LocalBridge: create a RenderReorder when the session is render-split and the Leg carries a lane; pass SRTT from the mosh-19g.6 process-local read (unknown → RenderReorder's 250 ms default) and fold its deadline into the leg I/O wait; write delivered frames as ClientOut::Injected (no offset); an upstream client→server FrameSplitter and one request_resync path writing encode_resync_frame between client frames as session DATA (offset-bearing); the §4 resume rule (one resync after WELCOME on every leg after the first, render-split sessions, any leg type); on lane-bearing legs, drop render-class frames arriving on the session stream (ack still advances). Probe: parse x-mosh-supersede-v1 from the status probe result (where 3a's mosh-19g.1.7 parses x-mosh-quic-v1) into BridgeParams and set Hello.render_split on every leg.

- [ ] Bridge test with a scripted leg: a resume after the first leg emits exactly one resync between client frames.
- [ ] Bridge test: render-class frames on the session stream of a lane-bearing leg are not forwarded; on an ssh leg they are.
- [ ] Bridge test with a scripted lane: a gap produces exactly one resync and no Chained frame reaches the client before the next SelfContained.
- [ ] Probe without the capability → HELLO has no render_split.
- [ ] No upstream file changed; clippy and fmt clean.

title: 3b: keeper render-split plumbing and lane queue handle
description:
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction--3b-supersede-design.md §1, §2 and Key abstractions (Hello, keeper Session/LegSlot, RenderLane producer queue). The unblocking artifact split out of mosh-19g.2.3. Hello gains optional render_split (serde default, skipped when false; old JSON parses). Session gains render_split, fixed from the HELLO that answered new. The RenderLane producer-side queue handle type (src/mosh/remote/render_lane.rs): a clearable bounded queue of 64 frames shared between the keeper thread (producer) and the lane's runtime task (consumer); offer(class, bytes) → Accepted | Rejected (Chained rejected when full; SelfContained clears the queue and is always accepted); a consumer pop that waits. This replaces 3a's placeholder render-lane slot type in KeeperLeg (extends mosh-19g.1.2's slot, same field). admit copies KeeperLeg's lane handle into LegSlot (None for Unix legs).
owns: Hello.render_split, Session.render_split, the lane queue handle type and its offer semantics, the KeeperLeg→LegSlot lane wiring at admit.
Files: src/mosh/session.rs, src/mosh/remote/{keeper,render_lane}.rs.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Hello round-trips with and without render_split; old HELLO JSON parses.
- [ ] Queue unit tests: capacity 64, Chained rejected when full, SelfContained clears and is accepted, consumer pop wakes on offer.
- [ ] Session.render_split is fixed at new and unchanged by a later HELLO (keeper unit test).
- [ ] Existing suites unchanged; no upstream file changed; clippy and fmt clean.

title: 3b: bridge RenderReorder
description:
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction/2026-10-28-mosh-phases-3-4-quic-prediction--3b-supersede-design.md §3 and Key abstractions (RenderReorder extended). Sans-IO state machine in src/mosh/render_reorder.rs: inputs RenderArrival {Header(seq,class), Complete(seq,class,bytes), Reset(seq)}, now, SRTT or unknown (250 ms); outputs frames to deliver, request-resync, next deadline. Rules: in-order delivery; gap on reset or overdue > max(SRTT,50 ms) after a later seq arrived; after a gap drop Chained until SelfContained; SelfContained releases immediately and supersedes missing seqs; Reset(n) with a known higher SelfContained header = supersede (gap, no request); other gaps request once; each leg starts in gap with the request counted as sent. Define the RenderArrival enum here; the bridge lane reader (mosh-19g.2.6) produces it.
owns: RenderReorder, RenderArrival.
Files: src/mosh/render_reorder.rs, src/mosh/mod.rs.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Unit tests with a fake clock for every rule above, including once-per-gap and the supersede-without-request case.
- [ ] No I/O in the module (pure); clippy and fmt clean.

title: 3b: keeper ChainGate, render-split routing and resync injection
description:
